<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}/grants"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The grant is install-wide, not per-user: it unlocks the capability for the plugin as a whole. What each call then does with the capability (e.g. whose hosts ctx.hosts.list() returns) is still scoped to whichever user's request triggered it.

>
  
</RequestSchema>
